data.name: Heavy Metal Racing
data.detailed_description:
Fuel up, strap in, and blast off into the loudest, wildest racing league in a post-apocalyptic world. In these turbocharged combat races, speed is only half the battle — the other half is heavy firepower and pure attitude. Outrun, outgun, and out-rock every challenger who dares step onto your track.

Rip across deadly circuits scattered across alien worlds, each packed with hazards, tight turns, and rivals eager to blow you to scrap. Earn cash, upgrade your ride, and pile on enough weapons to turn your machine into a rolling war machine. Missiles, mines, boosters — if it explodes, it belongs on your car.

Crank the volume, hit the gas, and leave nothing but smoking wreckage in your wake. Only the toughest survive. Only the fastest win. Only the loudest become legends.

Welcome to the ultimate rock-powered combat race.

Drive hard. Shoot straight. Rock on.
